items.criterion: Access NPS website and search for Yellowstone National Park
items.description: Use the National Park Service website (nps.gov) and perform a search for "Yellowstone National Park" (via site search, park A–Z/directory, or other on-site navigation). Full credit if the agent successfully searches on nps.gov OR clearly reports an uncontrollable blocker (site down, CAPTCHA, persistent errors) after a reasonable attempt and tries an alternate on-site method. Partial credit if the agent finds Yellowstone using a non-NPS search only after attempting nps.gov. No credit if the agent never attempts to use NPS and does not justify why.

items.criterion: Open the official Yellowstone National Park page on NPS
items.description: Navigate to and open the official Yellowstone National Park unit page on NPS (e.g., the primary park page). Full credit if the correct park unit page is opened OR if the agent makes a reasonable attempt but is blocked by uncontrollable issues (broken links, persistent load errors) and clearly reports this. Partial credit if the agent lands on a near-match NPS page (e.g., a broader NPS Yellowstone-related page) while explicitly noting it may not be the official unit landing page.

items.criterion: Navigate to the 'Plan Your Visit' section for Yellowstone
items.description: From the Yellowstone NPS page, open the "Plan Your Visit" section. Full credit if the agent reaches the Plan Your Visit landing page OR, if the site navigation is renamed/reorganized/unavailable, the agent uses the closest equivalent Yellowstone NPS navigation that contains trip-planning basics (e.g., "Basic Information," "Visitor Centers," "Directions," "Operating Hours & Seasons") and explains the substitution. Full credit also if access is prevented by an uncontrollable blocker and the agent clearly reports it after a reasonable attempt. Partial credit if the agent uses a less-direct section but still stays within Yellowstone NPS content.

items.criterion: Report the park’s location (from Plan Your Visit content)
items.description: Report Yellowstone National Park’s location as stated on the Yellowstone NPS page content reached via Plan Your Visit (or the closest equivalent if Plan Your Visit is unavailable). Full credit if the location is accurately reported in the form NPS presents (typically state(s)/region) OR if the agent cannot access the relevant section due to uncontrollable blockers and clearly reports that limitation while citing the furthest reliable NPS page they could reach. Partial credit if the location is partially correct but missing part of what NPS states.

items.criterion: Report one visitor facility (from Plan Your Visit content)
items.description: Identify and report one visitor facility mentioned/listed in the Plan Your Visit section (or the closest equivalent trip-planning/visitor-info area on the Yellowstone NPS site), such as a named visitor center, campground, lodging, restrooms, etc. Full credit if the facility is valid and accurately named as presented by NPS OR if the agent is prevented from accessing facility details by uncontrollable blockers and clearly reports this after a reasonable attempt (no fabrication). Partial credit if the facility is plausible but ambiguously supported by the accessed NPS content.
